# miniz 3.0.2 (vendored)

Single-file zip/deflate library used for ODT and EPUB packages (`src/ZipPackage.cpp`),
so zwriter needs no `zip`/`unzip` programs and no extra system library on Debian or macOS.

- Source: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/download/3.0.2/miniz-3.0.2.zip
- SHA-256 of that archive: `ada38db0b703a56d3dd6d57bf84a9c5d664921d870d8fea4db153979fb5332c5`
- `miniz.c`, `miniz.h` and `LICENSE` (MIT) are copied unchanged.
